messages:
maya: quick heads-up — the weekly dashboard is showing a ~22% drop in MQL → SQL for the cohort tied to last week's webinar. https://redwood.app/dash/weekly :eyes:
leo: do we know which attribution signal the dashboard is using? last-touch 7d vs 30d makes a big diff.
sasha: i pulled the raw cohort — utm_campaign is messy, some folks came via the blog post and got counted differently. also noticed form webhook spikes during the live Q&A.
maya: noted. dashboard shouldn't flip based on that. can we get a quick hypothesis list? :chart_with_downwards_trend:
nate: maybe SFDC routing got tweaked? saw a change in a rule last month but didn't think it'd affect this cohort. i'll triage lead assignment.
leo: i'll check inbound routing + dedupe logic. in the past missing utm_medium caused parser fallback to 'unknown' which breaks grouping.
sasha: FYI found an error in the form logs around 2026-03-18 17:12 — several 500s on /webhooks/form. suspect some leads failed to ingest. snippet: `2026-03-18T17:12:03Z ERROR POST /webhooks/form 500 -> dropped payload`
maya: oof. if leads dropped that's a plausible source of the delta. can analytics backfill from raw DB for that 48h window? @analytics-bot tagging you.
analytics-bot: scheduled_job: backfill_leads range=2026-03-18..2026-03-19 initiated. estimate ~45m. will post deltas to this thread when done.
leo: quick check: if backfill restores ~100–150 leads, conversion gap narrows by half. if not, blame attribution window and cross-channel dilution.
sasha: meanwhile i'll export the webhook retries and raw form payloads and drop into the drive folder: https://drive.redwood/marketing/webinar-forms/backfill
maya: action list: (1) @leo check routing + dedupe by EOD, (2) @sasha collect webhook payloads and confirm drops, (3) @nate validate SFDC assignment rules, (4) analytics-bot run backfill and post numbers. i'll update the dashboard note to call out "data under investigation" so stakeholders don't panic.
ne: ack — will ping if I see anything blocking.
leo: ack, starting checks now.
analytics-bot: backfill complete. delta: +128 leads for 2026-03-18..19, of which ~92 map to the webinar cohort. provisional uplift in MQL→SQL moves metric from 9.8% to ~11.6%. full report: https://redwood.app/backfills/1798765432
maya: thanks. numbers look like webhook drops explain most of the variance. we'll reconcile SFDC and re-run the weekly report. prepping a short note for Monday stakeholders. :thumbsup:
sasha: quick recommendation — add hidden webinar_id to the form and a small client-side retry on submit to reduce transient 500 losses.
maya: agree. pls schedule a tiny deploy for the hidden field this week. closing once SFDC reconcile done.
